cond_0077.intro: We are looking for a customer-focused engineer with dynamic rotating shaft seal knowledge and previous application engineering experience. This role involves building strong customer relationships and growing the [Company name masked] Industrial Seals Business. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with seal applications and customer engineering work.
cond_0077.responsibilities:
Operates as the main technical liaison between the Customer and [Company name masked] Industrial Seal Resources.
Drives new industrial business growth both internally and externally in cooperation with the Customer, Sales, Business Development, and Engineering.
Collaborates with Customer Engineers with and without sales as necessary to build relationships, utilize influence, discover opportunity, provide assistance and recommendations for new applications, overcome obstacles, and drive robust sealing solutions.
Communicates regularly between Customer, engineering, sales, business development, manufacturing, purchasing, and quality on current projects.
Procures and provides key information necessary for product design and product development to create optimized designs and mitigate risk for the Customer and for [Company name masked].
Creates Tech Responses and Presents Technical Reviews for Customers.
Provides technical assistance to customers for various applications in order to problem solve and mitigate sealing system challenges.
Collaborates with Product Development to ensure that new development projects will meet/exceed future customer expectations.
Manages customer testing programs to meet customer specifications for getting new products approved by the customer.
Provides necessary support documentation to the customer.
Drives and innovates for new or improved products and their applications.
Utilizes influence, experience, personal contacts, and professional reputation to satisfy the customer and alert the team to new growth opportunities, competitive threats, and needs for benchmarking and testing.
Organizes and presents at customer tech days to create growth opportunities.
Trains the Customer in Seals Technology and Products.
Works directly with Customers and internal departments on field returns, warranty concerns, and quality concerns.
Handles engineering specifications, seal specifications, DVPRs, Tech Responses, Test Procedures, Validation Reports, customer correspondence, PDS (Product Data Sheets), Sample Orders, and Tech Reviews.
Manages technical contacts, purchasing, quality, and manager relationships.
Supports new products and plans, customer drawings, pending patents, and development programs.
Gives direction and input to product engineers, test lab engineers, material and product development groups, sales, quality, and manufacturing.
Receives guidance in line with corporate objectives.

4-Year Mechanical Engineering degree or equivalent.
Minimum of 2 years of experience as a Seals Application Engineer.
Knowledge of dynamic seal design and testing with specialized customer application engineering seal experience.

Excellent oral and written communication skills, including the ability to influence others.

Demonstrates initiative and creative ability.
Exercises good discretionary decision making in line with corporate policy when dealing with customers or professional groups.
Good presentation skills.
